# Advance the field (world.advance)

## categories

[
  "world",
  "phenomena"
]

## demonstrations

[
  {
    "deterministic": false,
    "explanation": "Runs the real supervisor-owned field when configured; changing controls or advancing has persistent effects. Builder self-tests inject an unavailable fake (available=false), never a simulated observation.",
    "id": "advance",
    "input": {
      "ticks": 4
    },
    "title": "Try world.advance"
  }
]

## description

Advance one through one hundred simulation ticks, then return all sites. Simulation time is separate from wall time; waiting without this call has no effect. An advance beyond total tick 1000000 is refused without changes. The field is 6 by 6; coordinates run from 0 to 5. The complete state belongs to the supervisor and cannot be rewritten by workspace programs. Configuration must enable the phenomena service. No filesystem, network or other host permission is granted.

## failure_modes

  }
